create_SharedMLP: create a SharedMLP module with a list of channel sizes for 2D convolutional layers
build_Conv2d: build a Conv2d module with optional batch normalization and ReLU activation for feature extraction
create_Conv1d: create a Conv1d module with configurable kernel size, stride, padding, and batch normalization
create_FC: create a fully connected layer module with optional batch normalization and pre-activation support
build_BNMomentumScheduler: build a BNMomentumScheduler to dynamically adjust batch norm momentum across training epochs
